def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rest=sorted([c for c in cnt if c!=bg], key=lambda c:-cnt[c])
    border,dot=rest[0],rest[-1]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==border]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    dots=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==dot]
    colcount=Counter(c for r,c in cells)
    if max(colcount.values())>=3:
        bands={}
        for c in colcount:
            rs=sorted(r for r,cc in cells if cc==c)
            bands[c]=(rs[0],rs[-1])
        for c,(r0,r1) in bands.items():
            if any(r0<=r<=r1 for r,_ in dots): dotband=c
        c=dotband
        other=[cc for cc in bands if cc!=c][0]
        off=bands[other][0]-bands[c][0]
        for (dr,dc) in dots:
            step=1 if dc>c else -1
            cc=c+step
            while True:
                out[dr][cc]=dot
                if cc==dc: break
                cc+=step
            out[dr][dc]=4
            pr=dr+off
            if bands[other][0]<=pr<=bands[other][1]:
                for x in range(W):
                    if out[pr][x]!=border: out[pr][x]=dot
        return out
    # horizontal 3-pairs -> vertical tracks
    rows=sorted(set(r for r,c in cells))
    paircols=[]
    for r in rows:
        cs=sorted(c for rr,c in cells if rr==r)
        paircols.append(cs)
    tracks=[cs[-1] for cs in paircols]
    dcol=dots[0][1]
    dt=[t for t,cs in zip(tracks,paircols) if dcol in cs][0]
    ot=[t for t in tracks if t!=dt][0]
    def bcells(col): return sorted(r for r,c in cells if c==col)
    dr_,dc_=dots[0]
    bdt=bcells(dt)
    if any(b<dr_ for b in bdt):
        start=max(b for b in bdt if b<dr_); step=1
    else:
        start=min(b for b in bdt if b>dr_); step=-1
    r=start+step
    while 0<=r<H:
        if (r,dt)==(dr_,dc_):
            out[r][dt]=4; break
        out[r][dt]=dot
        r+=step
    bot=bcells(ot); top=min(bot)
    r=top+1
    while r<H:
        if out[r][ot]!=border: out[r][ot]=dot
        r+=1
    return out
